finding: Envelope check (model.py): H1B110 in line on the TA II input shaft does NOT fit - reducer hub Y−267…+3 plus coupling and the 316 mm motor puts the motor rear at Y≈491 vs sideframe Y330 / wheel inner face Y427, and the motor body (X 109–349 from the axle) hits the horn cheek (X 110–140).
